messages.subject: Avoiding extra call to lm()
parts:
I was recently asked how to modify the legend text of a plot with several best fit lines
(using lm() ) so that the R2 gets added to the legend text for each year.

The data.frame is of the form
df=data.frame(days=days,x=xvals,y=yvals)

and the plot commands are:
p1 = ggplot(df,aes(x,y,color=as.factor(year(days))))+geom_point()
p2 = p1 + geom_smooth(method="lm",se=FALSE)

My solution was to calculate the lm() again and create a new text label for the scale

r2s=ddply(df,.(year(days)),summarise, r2=format(summary(lm(y~x))$r.squared,digits=3))
r2s$texti=paste(r2s[,1]," (",r2s$r2,")",sep="")
p3 = p2+scale_color_discrete(labels=r2s$texti,name="Year (R2)")

Now, this works. However, calling lm() again annoys me. Is there a way to
get the results from the lm call within geom_smooth(method="lm") instead
of repeating the lm call ?

Halldor
